title: Contrastive World Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.22175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models trained via pixel reconstruction can struggle in visually complex environments, where irrelevant information dominates the objective and distract the model from information relevant to planning and control. We present Contrastive World Models, an approach for learning latent dynamics models without pixel reconstruction. Building on Dreamer, we replace observation reconstruction in the standard world model objective with a Deep InfoMax-like lower bound that maximizes the mutual information between state-action sequences and local patch features of future observations, encouraging state representations to retain information that is predictive of the future without requiring the model to reconstruct visually irrelevant details. We evaluate our approach in small-scale experiments across three settings of increasing visual complexity. translated_abstract: 通过像素重构训练的世界模型在视觉复杂的环境中可能表现不佳，因为无关信息会在目标函数中占主导地位，使模型的注意力从与规划和控制相关的信息上偏移。我们提出了对比世界模型，这是一种无需像素重构即可学习潜在动力学模型的方法。该方法基于Dreamer，用一种类似Deep InfoMax的下界来替代标准世界模型目标中的观测重构，该下界最大化状态-动作序列与未来观测的局部图块特征之间的互信息，鼓励状态表示保留对未来具有预测性的信息，而无需模型重构视觉上无关的细节。我们在三个视觉复杂度递增的设置中通过小规模实验评估了我们的方法。在默认设置下，我们的方法与Dreamer和动量预测基线表现相当，并在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出对比世界模型，用最大化状态-动作序列与未来观测局部特征之间互信息的对比式目标替代像素重构，使世界模型在视觉复杂环境中能学习到专注于规划与控制相关信息的潜在动力学模型。
en_tdlr: Contrastive World Models replaces pixel reconstruction in Dreamer-style world models with a Deep InfoMax-like objective that maximizes mutual information between state-action sequences and local features of future observations, enabling learning of latent dynamics that focus on planning-relevant information without being distracted by visually irrelevant details.
